[b]Goal of the game[/b]: win races. In each race, reach the target score before you run out of hands.
Every ante has 3 races. Win the Grand Prix at Ante 8 to become Champion.
This is the first race. The panel shows the target score and the reward.
This is your hand: 8 cars from your garage. Every car is a playing card with a rank (2 to Ace) and a suit.
This is your hand: 8 cards from your deck. Every card has a rank (2 to Ace) and a suit.
This is your hand: 8 cards from your deck. Every card has a rank (2 to TARDIS) and a suit.
Here is the target score of the race and your current score. Every hand you play adds to your score.
In every race you have [color=#2f8cff]4 hands[/color] and [color=#ff4b3e]3 discards[/color]. Use them well.

Not a strong hand? Select the cards you do not need and press [color=#ff4b3e]Discard[/color]: new cards come from your deck.

Beat the target to win the race!
You won the race! You get money: the reward, $1 for each hand left and interest on your savings.
This is the [color=#e8572f]Pit Stop[/color]. Here you spend money between races.
%s change how you score. Click one and press Buy.
